_help: Nirsh: edit this file on GitHub anytime. 'notes' = a private note that opens when she taps a reached milestone (and pops up when it happens). 'reveals' = After Dark only, a slow line-by-line reveal. 'birthdays' = what pops up on that person's birthday. Keys must match the milestone title exactly. Avoid & and the … character (the handwriting font doesn't have them).

notes.One week of us: A week. Seven days of me checking if this is real. It is. It keeps being real. - N
notes.One month: One month ago I didn't know what your good morning would do to my whole day. Now I plan the day around it.
notes.111 hours: 111 hours. Make a wish, Shady. I already made mine, and it's sitting next to me.
notes.One million seconds: A million seconds, and I'd hand over every single one of them again. Same terms.
notes.100 days: 100 days. I'd say it feels like yesterday, but yesterday I didn't have you this long. Today I do.
notes.100 days since 11:11: June 11th, 11:11 pm. We asked each other the time and then the world quietly stepped aside. 100 days later I'm still standing exactly where you left me: next to you.
notes.143 days: I. Love. You. One letter, four letters, three. 143 days, and I'm going to spell it out for the rest of them.
notes.Half a year: Half a year of you. Half of one year, out of all the years I plan to have. Do the math, love, I'm just getting started.
notes.Our first Valentine's Day: I never needed a day to love you. But if the world insists on one, I'm giving this one to you. Every inch of it.
notes.Our first new year: Of all the countdowns I've ever done, this is the first one where I wasn't hoping for a new life. I already had the one I wanted.
notes.Our first year: One year. 31,557,600 seconds, and you were in every single one that mattered. Happy first of many, Shady.
notes.A year since 11:11: A year ago the time kept disappearing around us. Turns out it was making room for this. Make a wish, love. It already came true.
notes.1,000 days: 1,000 days. If I wrote one reason for each, I'd run out of paper before I ran out of reasons.
notes.Two years: Two years in and I still get that little jolt when your name lights up my phone. Don't you dare fix it.
notes.Five years: Five years. We built a whole life out of small seconds. Look at it. Look at what we made.
notes.A decade of us: A decade. You've seen me at my worst and stayed for my average. I'd say that's real love. - N
notes.Ten thousand days: Ten thousand days. Nobody gets to keep this long, so I'm saying it plainly: I chose you every single one of them.

Sixty-nine hours: you know what that number means.
i've been thinking about it all day.
690 hours: a whole month of 6, 9, and you.
and i haven't had nearly enough of any of them.
Sixty-nine days: now think about me saying it back.
close the door. this one's ours.
6.9 million seconds: and every one of them, wanting you.
especially the ones when you weren't looking.
6,969 hours: twice the fun. i did the math.
696 days: that's me. then you. then me again.
6,969 days: and i still want you the way i did the first night.

Shady: Happy birthday, my love. The world got you today and I got lucky enough to be the one counting. Today every second is yours.
Today the clock runs on your time, Shady. Happy birthday. You are the best thing that ever happened to my seconds.
Nirsh: It's his birthday, love. Tell him. He's been counting every second of you since June 19th.
Today is Nirsh's day. Happy birthday to the one who made this clock just to prove how much he adores you.
